toolkits.title: Gmail
toolkits.access: Doddy can list your recent emails (sender, subject, a short preview) and read one email aloud when you ask, after you say yes. It can write drafts, send an email, reply, forward, archive, mark read or unread, star, and move an email to Trash, each only after you tap the card that shows exactly what will happen. It never deletes email for good.

tools.name: check_email
tools.title: Check my email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest emails: sender, subject and a short preview. It doesn't open full messages.

tools.name: read_email
tools.title: Read an email
tools.blurb: Reads one email aloud when you ask, the newest that matches. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.title: Draft an email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Gmail after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it.

tools.name: draft_email_reply
tools.title: Draft a reply
tools.blurb: Creates a reply draft in an email's conversation, to its sender, after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: send_email
tools.title: Send an email
tools.blurb: Sends an email from your Gmail after you tap Send on the card, which shows the recipient, subject and full text. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.title: Send a reply
tools.blurb: Sends a reply in an email's conversation, to its sender, after you tap Send reply. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.title: Forward an email
tools.blurb: Forwards one email, with its attachments, after you tap Forward on the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: change_email
tools.title: Archive or mark email
tools.blurb: Archives, marks read or unread, or stars one email after you tap the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: trash_email
tools.title: Move email to Trash
tools.blurb: Moves one email to Gmail's Trash after you tap the card. It can be restored for 30 days; Doddy never deletes for good. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Google Drive
toolkits.access: Doddy can find files by name (name, type, last change) after you say yes, and create a private Google Doc after you tap the card that shows its name and text. It can't open, change, share or delete your other files.

tools.name: find_drive_file
tools.title: Find a Drive file
tools.blurb: Looks up files by name and shows name, type and last change. It can't open or change files.

tools.name: create_drive_doc
tools.title: Create a Google Doc
tools.blurb: Creates a private Google Doc with the text on the card after you tap Create doc. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Notion
toolkits.access: Doddy can search the titles of pages you shared with it, and read one page aloud when you ask, after you say yes. It can create a page, add text to the end of a page, or move a page to Notion's trash, each only after you tap the card that shows exactly what will happen. It never deletes for good.

tools.name: search_notion
tools.title: Search Notion
tools.blurb: Finds page titles shared with Doddy. It doesn't read the pages.

tools.name: read_notion_page
tools.title: Read a Notion page
tools.blurb: Reads one page aloud when you ask, the best match among pages shared with Doddy. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: create_notion_page
tools.title: Create a Notion page
tools.blurb: Creates a page inside a page shared with Doddy after you tap Create page. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: append_notion_page
tools.title: Add to a Notion page
tools.blurb: Adds text to the end of one page after you tap Add. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: trash_notion_page
tools.title: Move a Notion page to the trash
tools.blurb: Moves one page to Notion's trash after you tap the card. It can be restored there. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Todoist
toolkits.access: Doddy can list your open tasks after you say yes, and add a task, mark one done, change its due date or rename it, each after you tap the card. It can't delete tasks: Todoist deletes for good.

tools.name: list_todoist_tasks
tools.title: List my tasks
tools.blurb: Lists your open Todoist tasks, for example what's due today.

tools.name: add_todoist_task
tools.title: Add a task
tools.blurb: Adds a Todoist task after you tap Add on the card.

tools.name: complete_todoist_task
tools.title: Complete a task
tools.blurb: Marks a Todoist task done after you tap Complete. The card shows the task as Todoist has it.

tools.name: move_todoist_task
tools.title: Change a task's date
tools.blurb: Changes a Todoist task's due date after you tap Move. It can't change the task's text.

tools.name: rename_todoist_task
tools.title: Rename a task
tools.blurb: Changes a Todoist task's text after you tap Rename. The card shows the task as Todoist has it. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Outlook
toolkits.access: Doddy can list your recent Outlook emails (sender, subject, a short preview), read one email aloud when you ask, and read your Outlook calendar for the days you ask about, after you say yes. It can create drafts, send, reply, forward, mark read or flag, archive or move an email to Deleted Items, and add, change, delete or answer calendar events, each only after you tap the card that shows exactly what will happen. It never deletes anything for good.

tools.name: check_outlook_email
tools.title: Check my Outlook email
tools.blurb: Lists your newest Outlook emails: sender, subject and a short preview. It doesn't open full messages. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: read_outlook_email
tools.title: Read an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Reads one Outlook email aloud when you ask, the newest that matches. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: draft_outlook_email
tools.title: Draft an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Creates a draft in Outlook after you tap Create on the card. Doddy never sends it. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: read_outlook_calendar
tools.title: Read my Outlook calendar
tools.blurb: Reads your Outlook calendar for the days you ask about: title, time and place. It can't change events. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: create_outlook_event
tools.title: Add an Outlook event
tools.blurb: Adds an event to your Outlook calendar after you tap Add on the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: change_outlook_event
tools.title: Change an Outlook event
tools.blurb: Moves or renames one event after you tap Change. Its guests are told. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: delete_outlook_event
tools.title: Delete an Outlook event
tools.blurb: Deletes one event after you tap Delete. It goes to Deleted Items. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: accept_outlook_invite
tools.title: Accept an Outlook invitation
tools.blurb: Answers yes or maybe to one invitation after you tap the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: decline_outlook_invite
tools.title: Decline an Outlook invitation
tools.blurb: Declines one invitation after you tap the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: send_outlook_email
tools.title: Send an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Sends an email after you tap Send on the card, which shows the recipient, subject and full text. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: reply_outlook_email
tools.title: Send an Outlook reply
tools.blurb: Replies to one email's sender after you tap Send reply. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: forward_outlook_email
tools.title: Forward an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Forwards one email, with its attachments, after you tap Forward. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: move_outlook_email
tools.title: Archive or bin an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Moves one email to Archive or Deleted Items (or back to the inbox) after you tap the card. Never deletes for good. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: mark_outlook_email
tools.title: Mark an Outlook email
tools.blurb: Marks one email read or unread, or flags it, after you tap the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Google Calendar
toolkits.access: Doddy can read your Google Calendar for the days you ask about, after you say yes, and add, move, rename or delete an event, or answer an invitation, each only after you tap the card that shows exactly what will happen. Deleted events stay in Google Calendar's trash for 30 days. It never changes calendar settings or sharing.

tools.name: read_google_calendar
tools.title: Read my Google Calendar
tools.blurb: Reads your Google Calendar for the days you ask about: title, time and place, after you say yes. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: create_google_event
tools.title: Add a Google event
tools.blurb: Adds an event to your Google Calendar after you tap Add on the card. No guests, no Meet link. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: change_google_event
tools.title: Change a Google event
tools.blurb: Moves or renames one event after you tap Change. Its guests are told. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: delete_google_event
tools.title: Delete a Google event
tools.blurb: Deletes one event after you tap Delete. It stays in Google Calendar's trash for 30 days. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

tools.name: answer_google_invite
tools.title: Answer a Google invitation
tools.blurb: Answers yes, no or maybe to one invitation after you tap the card. On when you connect the account; switch it off any time.

toolkits.title: Web search
toolkits.access: Doddy can look things up on the web when you ask: your search words go to Doddy's server and on to a search provider through Monid. No sign-in. Doddy pays for searches and there's a daily limit.

tools.name: web_search
tools.title: Search the web
tools.blurb: Looks up current information (opening hours, news, prices) and tells you where it came from.

tools.name: news_search
tools.title: Search the news
tools.blurb: Looks up recent news articles when you ask and says where each came from. Doddy pays per search. On until you switch it off.

tools.name: find_places
tools.title: Find places
tools.blurb: Finds places (cafés, shops, opening hours, ratings) near a town you name. Doddy pays per search. On until you switch it off.
